comparators.note: Result/1 or PureResult of the operation, exact (JCS) with explicit rules.
getSnapshot() Result/1 after the operation: envelope, presentation delta, selection, viewRevision.
Change events (DESIGN §8.1 L606) emitted by the operation, in order, exact.
undo() then redo() Results and their events after a commit, or the refused undo() probe after a refusal or no-op; root transaction count.
Command input staged at the profile transaction adapter entry by the gesture, exact.
Refusal Result/1 surfaced as the diagnostic outcome of a refused gesture (§8.2 L633).
UI outcome of a gesture that stages nothing (prompt, connection or reconnection refused, cancelled).
Host download callbacks with the prepared and serialized artifacts (final-only).
Read-only viewer/preview surface inventory.
Upstream entry classification of the canvas business-profile mode.
Per-step observations of a multi-step case, in order.
Static dependency/import inventory of the package entry points.
Workshop host callbacks (onChange count, automatic saves).
Fragment written to the clipboard by cut.
The §5.1 profileIdentity record carried by the compiled profile.
Result of the getter called right after the operation (for example getDefinitions after a refused load).
Python headless twin outputs for the same command or query input; presentation members are excluded (runtime-specific layout, K18).

Python comparator lot5-py/compile-outcome: loadProfile then compileProfile on the profileArtifact bytes with the base and descriptors artifacts: the first refusal as {status, code, diagnostics}, or the success {status: ok, payload, diagnostics} whose payload (the compiled profile, no wire shape) is the {$unsealed: compiled-profile} member.
Python comparator lot5-py/compiled-identity: the profileIdentity record (DESIGN R3.3 §5.1) carried by the compiled profile of a compile success, exact under profile-c14n/2.

Setup part of the Python comparator lot5-py/step-outcomes: one headless bridge per case created with the descriptors artifact (or the bridge input), the envelope input loaded (with importedDi when given) and the compiled profileArtifact activated; the setDefinitions and activateBusinessProfile results {load, activate} equal the setup outcomes under profile-c14n/2 after each {$unsealed} marker is replaced by the actual member it marks (the member must exist).

Python comparator lot5-py/step-outcomes: after the setup, the sequence steps run in order; every actual step result equals its outcome template under profile-c14n/2 after each {$unsealed} marker is replaced by the actual member it marks (the member must exist); equal/differ compare a pointer with a saved result. Placeholders {$current} and {$saved} are resolved before the request runs (Python SPEC_PROFILE_COMMANDS_PY.md section 8).
RFC 8785 JCS bytes, UTF-16 key order (DESIGN R3.3 §3.1): the canonical form every lot-5 comparator compares; mechanism comparator of the vendored Python cases, observing no member of its own.
Allocated IDs recompute (DESIGN R3.3 §3.2): the vendored Python cases seal stable-id/1 values literally; mechanism comparator, observing no member of its own.

notes: Lot-5 UI surface expectations, hand-authored from DESIGN R3.3, the block-A public contracts and the block-B harmonization decisions; no interpreter output was used.

pathBase is the repository-relative directory of every path below; files covers every case, fixture and vendored file; manifest.json, clauses.json, design-excerpts.json, README.md, author/ and comparators/ are pinned by seal.json.
Every comparator is the pinned executable lot5-compare/1 with zero tolerance; a member is excluded only by an explicit $unsealed marker whose reason is listed in unsealedReasons.

Block-B parity sync (BLOCKB-PARITY-SYNC row PS-H25): the cases lot5-py-* are the Python lot-5 parity records vendored unchanged, except the refusal code of the 2 compile refusals of the CR-10 arbitration (README "CR-10 arbitration"); vendor/py/ holds the Python seal's bytes unchanged and the README lists the re-expressed roles and comparator ids.

unsealedReasons.compiled-profile: Payload of a successful compileProfile: an opaque in-process compiled object; only its identity record is sealed.
unsealedReasons.event-transaction: transactionId of a load or theme change event: DESIGN §8.1 L606 names no transaction for these origins.
unsealedReasons.export-adapter: IR geometry/style records, occurrence keys, counter ID assignment, page set and serialized bytes of prepareExport: its layout stage is the runtime-specific canvas auto-layout (K18) with unpinned text measurement (E-20).
unsealedReasons.history-epoch: historyEpoch is a session-local counter excluded from parity (DESIGN §3.1 L268).
unsealedReasons.lot4-presentation: presentation.layout, themeId, overrides, diStyles, activePageId, and importedDi when no record was supplied at load, of a vendored Python case: lot-4 layout adapter and theme selection; an explicitly loaded importedDi record is sealed exactly (Python vocabulary).
unsealedReasons.lot4-view-revision: viewRevision of payloads, snapshots and events of a vendored Python case: §9.2 digest tuple over the lot-4 layout (DESIGN §3.1 L268); lot 5 compares it relationally (Python vocabulary).
unsealedReasons.raw-lint-transport: report.rawStandardFindings of the two vendored Python witnesses whose profile runs the vendored standard lint rules: raw upstream report records are the frozen upstream comparator (DESIGN §3.1 L272, §6.4 L508, L520); their Report/2 record shape is not fixed (BLOCKB-PARITY-SYNC PS-10, E-42) (Python vocabulary).
unsealedReasons.replacement-map-multi-create: report.idMap of a conversion that creates several ID-bearing elements: harmonization D7 and the Python binding define the replacement map for exactly one created element only.
unsealedReasons.session-history-epoch: historyEpoch of a vendored Python case: session-local counter excluded from parity (DESIGN §3.1 L268) (Python vocabulary).
unsealedReasons.session-subscription: subscriptionId of a vendored Python case: session-local, excluded from parity (DESIGN §8.1 L606) (Python vocabulary).
unsealedReasons.twin-presentation: Presentation members (viewRevision, layout, selection) of the Python headless twin: its layout is a DI transcription, runtime-specific (harmonization K18); semantic members stay exact.
